items.title: Trump administration set to ease Biden-era fuel economy rules

items.title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery as drone attacks intensify
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ukraine said it struck Russia’s Ilsky oil refinery in the Black Sea region of Krasnodar overnight, setting the facility ablaze as both countries reported large-scale drone attacks, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: U.S. pressure campaign cuts Iran’s banking and air links as war drags on - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. is intensifying efforts to isolate Iran from international banking and aviation networks, with several regional governments cutting financial and air links with Tehran amid the continuing war, the Wall Street Journal reported exclusively.
